fact: The Eswatini Communications Commission hosted the 13th annual general meeting of the Communications Regulators' Association of Southern Africa (CRASA) at Ezulwini on 11-13 April 2024, after a conference on 8-10 April.
title: 13th AGM OF CRASA and "Innovation for Better Regulation" conference to be held in Eswatini, 8-13 April 2024
